text:
Lead 2026-10-04, landing G3 against Studio:
- Studio adapts to MapPlacement.InWindow and TrialFailed(tally) on p0-g3, in the same batch as G3 (lane-readybatch). The protocol wire keeps the token 'InMap' for InWindow, so existing pins are unchanged.
- TrialFailed is a new wire token carrying its tally. It is a protocol minor: whichever of G3 or pairRows lands first takes 1.9, and the later ones renumber at landing.
- Rendering: a TrialFailed fixation never contributes to the map. It is drawn in the OutsideWindow(FailTrial) style, but its text and announcement say the trial failed and give the tally, so it stays distinguishable from a fixation outside the window.
- The fake backend marks the in-window fixations of a failing trial TrialFailed.
